tasks.title: Create and Switch to Lab Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure you are using the model `mod7-cos-lab`.
hints: Run `juju switch mod7-cos-lab` or `juju add-model mod7-cos-lab` if not present.

tasks.title: Configure Model Logging Level
tasks.instructions: Set the model logging configuration so that the root logger level is set to `DEBUG` (`<root>=DEBUG`).

tasks.title: Deploy Workload Application
tasks.instructions: Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `web-app` into the `mod7-cos-lab` model.

tasks.title: Deploy Monitoring Receiver Application
tasks.instructions: Deploy a second `ubuntu` charm with application name `metrics-collector` into the model.
